nusmp.page.book_water.valkyrie_dress: Valkyrie Dress - Noelle's water becomes armour: pearl-white plate with a gold border, a halo and great wings of water feathers. In Noelle Silva's grimoire it is the Saint Valkyrie Dress: a second pair of wings, the aureole, a gold sash and a hovering lance of water. Cast it and the armour forges on; it stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. While it is on you are faster, harder to hurt and hit harder. The cast also gives thirty seconds of Speed, Strength, Resistance and Jump. A little mana is paid every second.
nusmp.page.book_water.mermaid_form: Mermaid Form - the armour turns into a tail of sea-blue scales with twin tails of hair, fin ears and a shell top, and a trident of ice-water hovers at your hand. You breathe water, swim fast and mend slowly in the sea; on land the tail slows you. Cast it again to end it. Any Water mage may use it; Noelle's grimoire draws the full form.
nusmp.page.book_water.sea_dragon_god_for: Sea Dragon God Form - the contract with the sea god Leviathan: horned, winged armour of dragon scales, a dragon-head cannon on your arm and a tail that sweeps the ground. A roar at the start hits foes within six blocks. Strength, Resistance and speed for up to five minutes; cast it again to end it. Only Noelle Silva's grimoire holds this page.
nusmp.page.book_water.black_dragon_form: Black Dragon Form - the dark side of the dragon: black scales veined with blue flame, torn wings, red eyes. A shockwave at the start hits foes within eight blocks. Strong Strength, Resistance and speed, but it lasts only ninety seconds and leaves you exhausted for three minutes (slowness and weakness, never hunger). It will not close over a devil's pact. Only Noelle Silva's grimoire holds this page.
nusmp.noelle.black_exhausted: The black scales crumble. The dragon leaves you hollow.
